name: v0.34.0 - DB2 Provider Support
description: Focused IBM DB2 provider package and tests using IBM.EntityFrameworkCore for net8.0 and net10.0, adding DB2 provider behavior, capability profiles, optimized clean-context save dispatch, diagnostics-gated PIT/bridge read dispatch, opt-in live DB2 evidence, and consumer-owned database/container setup. Planning release v0.34.0 maps to package versions 8.34.0 and 10.34.0.
